build_experiment_config: build an ExperimentConfig dataclass to define a JAX RL agent experiment with builder, network factory, and environment factory
build_offline_experiment_config: build an OfflineExperimentConfig dataclass to define an offline RL experiment with demonstration dataset and learner steps
create_checkpointing_config: create a CheckpointingConfig dataclass to configure checkpoint frequency, directory, max to keep, and TTL for RL experiments
create_default_evaluator: create a default evaluator factory that returns an EnvironmentLoop with actor, logger, and counter for policy evaluation
create_evaluator_factories: create evaluator factories from an ExperimentConfig using get_evaluator_factories to construct default or custom evaluators
